text: Original Roman-era elemental arena instrumental. A dramatic entrance of one deep hide drum and tense bowed low strings, then restrained hide-and-iron percussion beneath a clearly audible, memorable melodic phrase. The melody must begin within the first two seconds and repeat with a small answering variation; do not deliver a texture-only drone. Leave space for combat. No singing, choir, modern drum kit or electronic dance beat. 96 BPM, 4/4 requested. Twenty-second style sketch, keep musical movement alive through the end. A soft double-reed solo plays a five-note rising then falling Dorian melody above the drums. It is a subtle intimate instrument, clearly identifiable in the midrange, answered by two plucked lyre notes. Dark courage, restrained menace, melodic rather than bombastic.
